title: Ancient Georgian Grape Delivers Big Value
description: Georgia produces some of the most interesting and best-value wines on the market. While wine lovers often turn to France, Italy and Spain for a dependable bottle of red, this small country at the crossroads of Europe and Asia has a winemaking history stretching back 8,000 years. And, as Bedoba Saperavi 2023 demonstrates, there is plenty to discover.
